# Anselmi Media Downloader

> Free online tool to download videos, photos, reels and galleries from public X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram and Reddit posts. No account required. Paste a public post URL and save media instantly.

Anselmi Media Downloader helps people save public social media content for personal use. Only public posts are supported. Media is fetched from platform CDNs; this site does not host copyrighted files. Available in English, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese.

## Main site

- [Home (English)](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/): Multi-platform media downloader landing page in English
- [Home (Spanish)](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/es/): Página principal del descargador de medios en español
- [Home (French)](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/fr/): Page d’accueil du téléchargeur de médias en français
- [Home (German)](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/de/): Startseite des Media-Downloaders auf Deutsch
- [Home (Portuguese)](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/pt/): Página inicial do baixador de mídia em português

## Platform pages

- [X / Twitter video downloader](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/x-twitter-video-downloader): Download videos and photos from public X (Twitter) posts in MP4
- [TikTok video downloader](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/tiktok-video-downloader): Download TikTok videos without watermark when available
- [Instagram downloader](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/instagram-downloader): Save Instagram Reels, photos, carousels, stories and highlights
- [Reddit video downloader](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/reddit-video-downloader): Download Reddit videos with audio, GIFs and gallery images

- [Sitemap](https://social-media.anselmidev.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of indexable pages
